follow-up time: Until delivery for cesarean delivery outcome, 1 year prior to week 20 of gestation for PIH and gestational diabetes
cohort: 41,660 pregnant women with and without asthma who delivered between 1990 and 2002
finding: While severe asthma was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, asthma severity and control were not significantly associated with gestational diabetes or PIH, though further research is needed to clarify the relationship between asthma control and PIH.
